description: PolicyEngine 'outputs' that are really inputs requested with null: PE echoes the input (or its model default) or derives a string form. Answered from the household itself, no engine call. Kept in one file so the list of what is echoed rather than computed is explicit.

state_code_str.notes: PE derives the two-letter string from state_code / state_name.

notes: client-dq9pluou requests state_code_str and age as outputs; PE returns CA and 40.
